items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Sy Oliver introduced me to him, see, and he says, I ought to have you on the show sometime, but never did.

ctx.x: Now, how can -- and Leonard Feather was there and many other great dignitaries was there. How is it, when I look through the discography of musicians in the '70s or farther back than that, that I don't find the name Whaley? It disturbs me greatly.
I wonder why, just like Long John Nebel, see. Sy Oliver introduced me to him, see, and he says, I ought to have you on the show sometime, but never did.

Well, I'm so happy to have you on this one and have you tell your story. I just wish -- you've been the most literate of any person I've ever interviewed. Your dates, you're the brightest, chronologically you know how to bring it about, which I'm most grateful for.
